```python
import gurobipy as gp
from gurobipy import GRB

# Job data
jobs = {
    "0": {"processing_time": 42, "due_date": 325, "weight": 4},
    "1": {"processing_time": 8, "due_date": 495, "weight": 2},
    "2": {"processing_time": 49, "due_date": 452, "weight": 5},
    "3": {"processing_time": 64, "due_date": 560, "weight": 4},
    "4": {"processing_time": 32, "due_date": 538, "weight": 10},
    "5": {"processing_time": 90, "due_date": 552, "weight": 1},
    "6": {"processing_time": 52, "due_date": 455, "weight": 9},
    "7": {"processing_time": 68, "due_date": 238, "weight": 3},
    "8": {"processing_time": 59, "due_date": 363, "weight": 2},
    "9": {"processing_time": 34, "due_date": 140, "weight": 9},
    "10": {"processing_time": 86, "due_date": 409, "weight": 9},
    "11": {"processing_time": 66, "due_date": 294, "weight": 1},
    "12": {"processing_time": 18, "due_date": 301, "weight": 2},
    "13": {"processing_time": 98, "due_date": 115, "weight": 5},
    "14": {"processing_time": 45, "due_date": 210, "weight": 5}
}

# Create a new model
model = gp.Model("single_machine_scheduling")
model.Params.OutputFlag = 0

# Sets and parameters
n = len(jobs)
job_ids = list(jobs.keys())

# Variables
C = model.addVars(job_ids, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="C")  # Completion times
T = model.addVars(job_ids, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="T")  # Tardiness
x = model.addVars(job_ids, job_ids, vtype=GRB.BINARY, name="x")  # Sequencing variables

# Objective: Minimize the total weighted tardiness
model.setObjective(gp.quicksum(jobs[j]["weight"] * T[j] for j in job_ids), GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Constraints
# Completion time constraints
for j in job_ids:
    model.addConstr(C[j] >= jobs[j]["processing_time"] + gp.quicksum(jobs[i]["processing_time"] * x[i, j] for i in job_ids if i != j))

# Tardiness constraints
for j in job_ids:
    model.addConstr(T[j] >= C[j] - jobs[j]["due_date"])

# Sequencing constraints
for i in job_ids:
    for j in job_ids:
        if i != j:
            model.addConstr(x[i, j] + x[j, i] == 1)

# Solve the model
model.optimize()

# Extract the sequence
sequence = sorted(job_ids, key=lambda j: C[j].X)

# Output the result
result = {
    "sequence": sequence,
    "objective_value": model.ObjVal
}

print(result)
